facts.business: Sansera Engineering Limited manufactures high-precision machined components for automotive (ICE, technology-agnostic, xEV) and non-automotive sectors including aerospace, defence, semiconductor equipment, agriculture, and industrial applications.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capex investment in plant and machinery
Additional forging capacity at Pantnagar Plant 6
Higher machining capacity at Bengaluru Plant 2

guidance_or_targets.statement: Increase emerging segments to 40% of revenue mix

key_risks: Volatile global backdrop affecting order inflows from international customers
Forward-looking statements subject to assumptions, risks and uncertainties
Dependence on traditional IC engine components
Execution risk in diversification to aerospace, defence, semiconductor and xEV segments
facts.related_party_note: Nichidai Sansera Private Limited is a 60:40 joint venture with Nichidai Corporation, Japan. Sansera will invest ₹500 million in one or more tranches.
